scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html','styles.css','script.js','favicon.svg','_headers','_redirects'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); }); console.log('Build & Security Headers Synchronized successfully!');"
